verdict.rationale: Preventing a merchant's data from being used for AI training is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS commerce platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or training-exclusion control. The AI-powered docs search and llms.txt items concern documentation features, not data-use controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
